fixtures: acme-tools and notes-kit are small plugin directories, and marketplace.json is a marketplace index, copied into the run's data/ folder. The plugin directories are kept under evals/files/.trees/vendor/ so the repo's own skill discovery skips them.

evals.name: acme-tools-audit
evals.prompt: Is data/acme-tools ready to ship to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot CLI? It has .claude-plugin/ and .cursor-plugin/ manifests, a .mcp.json, hooks/hooks.json, one skill and one agent.
evals.expected_output: Not ready. The plugin name acme.tools has a dot, which Copilot rejects (names must be kebab-case). There is no .codex-plugin/plugin.json. skills/summarize has a metadata field, which triggers Claude Code's demotion bug. agents/reviewer.md cannot ship to Codex (no agents), and its skills: key and Claude-only tools are inert on Copilot. hooks.json lacks Copilot's "version": 1 and uses three-level nesting. The acme-docs server is HTTP, which Codex does not support, and there is no mcp.json for Cursor. Reported as a per-vendor readiness table and a HIGH/MED/LOW list naming the affected vendors.
assertions: Gives a readiness line for each of Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot CLI
Gives a prioritized issue list with HIGH/MED/LOW levels, each naming the vendors it affects
Flags the plugin name acme.tools as rejected by Copilot because it is not kebab-case
Flags the missing .codex-plugin/plugin.json manifest
Flags the metadata field in skills/summarize/SKILL.md as a Claude Code demotion risk
Flags that Codex does not support agents, so agents/reviewer.md will not ship there
Flags hooks/hooks.json as missing Copilot's "version": 1 or using a nesting shape Copilot does not bind
Flags that the HTTP acme-docs MCP server is not supported by Codex
Flags that Cursor needs mcp.json without the dot

evals.name: marketplace-copilot
evals.prompt: Will our marketplace install in Copilot CLI? data/marketplace.json is our .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.
evals.expected_output: No. Copilot accepts only relative paths, github and url sources, and one bad entry fails the whole index, not just that plugin. acme-infra uses git-subdir and acme-lint uses npm, both rejected; docs.helper has a dot in its name, which is not kebab-case. The github source with a path (acme-deploy) and the relative paths are fine. Fix: publish a Copilot-safe .github/plugin/marketplace.json alongside the Claude index, which Copilot reads first. HIGH.
assertions: Says one unsupported entry makes the whole index fail in Copilot, so no plugin from it installs
Names the git-subdir source (acme-infra) as rejected by Copilot
Names the npm source (acme-lint) as rejected by Copilot
Flags docs.helper as not kebab-case
Does not flag the github source with a path (acme-deploy) as a Copilot problem
Recommends a separate Copilot-safe .github/plugin/marketplace.json next to the Claude index
Rates the problem HIGH

evals.name: notes-kit-ready
evals.prompt: Before we tag 0.3.0: audit data/notes-kit for cross-vendor readiness. It has .claude-plugin/, .cursor-plugin/ and .codex-plugin/ manifests, .mcp.json plus mcp.json, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and one skill.
evals.expected_output: Ready on all four vendors. Copilot needs no manifest of its own: it falls back to .claude-plugin/plugin.json, and the name notes-kit is kebab-case. The skill is valid, the MCP server is stdio with type stdio (fine on Codex too), Cursor has its no-dot mcp.json, and the Codex manifest points at skills and .mcp.json. No HIGH issues.
assertions: Reports Copilot CLI as ready
Does not ask for a Copilot-specific plugin manifest, and says Copilot falls back to .claude-plugin/plugin.json
Reports Codex as ready, the stdio MCP server included
Does not report a HIGH issue
Does not report problems with skills/find-note/SKILL.md
